messages:
lee: quick follow-up from last night's noisy pages. need owners for tuning + short timelines so we don't get repeat blasts. proposed items:
- bump infra CPU alert threshold (owner: rachel) 72h
- implement error dedupe (owner: omar) 7d
- adjust paging policy for low/med sev (owner: nina) 48h + 14d grandfather
- add suppression rule for known flappers (owner: rachel) 14d
please ack and call out blockers. tagging @ops-bot to make a tracker. :wave:

rachel: ack. i'll take CPU + suppression. plan: bump to 0.92 in staging, run 24h dry-run, then push. will post grafana link.

omar: taking dedupe. prefer `job:error_sig` key to avoid per-instance noise. i'll open PR by Thu and add a CI smoke test.

nina: i'll update paging policy and rota hours. question: confirm daytime window 09:00-18:00 PT and grandfathering 14 days?

lee: yes to both. also exclude control-plane hosts from suppression list, i'll DM them.

ops-bot: Task created: https://tasks.company/INFR-3001 "Alert tuning: thresholds, dedupe, paging, suppression" assigned to [rachel, omar, nina] due 2026-05-20 :white_check_mark:

oncall-rotations: FYI i'll adjust the rota rules once nina's PR merges so daytime pages route correctly.

rachel: pasted rule diff I'll test tomorrow:
```
# old
expr: avg by(instance)(rate(node_cpu_seconds_total{mode!="idle"}[5m])) > 0.85
# proposed
expr: avg by(instance)(rate(node_cpu_seconds_total{mode!="idle"}[5m])) > 0.92
labels:
  severity: medium
```

omar: PR opened for dedupe template: `dedupe_key: '{{ job }}:{{ error_sig }}'`. adding unit smoke.

nina: prepping paging policy PR, will include runbook note and 14-day rollback plan. PR by EOD tomorrow.

lee: great. i'll fold these into the postmortem actions and close the task when all items are done. final checklist:
- rachel: threshold bump + suppression rule (72h/14d)
- omar: dedupe PR + CI smoke (7d)
- nina: paging policy PR + rota change (48h)
flag here if you need more time. thanks :thumbsup:
